name: Campsite tent pair (front-facing A-frame tent + side-profile tent)

anchor.note: dx/dy are tile offsets from the top-left of the footprint; the front-facing tent opens toward the viewer with the side-profile tent pitched beside it.

offset_basis_summary: Tent_1 (front) and Tent_4 (side) are semantically the same tent model rendered from two different sheet bands (front row y304, side row y368) with no direct spatial relationship, so this composition is hand-authored to place a front-view and side-view tent side by side as a plausible two-tent campsite.

pieces.notes: Pitched at an angle to the front tent to suggest a small cluster rather than a single row.

variants.tent_count: Add camping_tent_2/tent_3 (front) or tent_5/tent_6 (side) copies for a larger campsite; keep front-facing tents on the near row.
variants.color_note: Registry currently only links Tent_1-3 (front) and Tent_4-6 (side) singles; treat all three numbered variants as the same tent skin rather than distinct colors.

notes: Curated composite (not sheet-derived): places a front-view and side-view tent from the same model together so the campsite reads as a small cluster instead of two disconnected single-tent stamps.
